name: BMAD
description: Compact CLike-owned BMAD methodology profile metadata. BMAD is a governed methodology profile, not an executor or a parallel pipeline.

analyst.title: Analyst
analyst.summary: Frames product intent, problem context, users, outcomes, constraints, and discovery assumptions.

pm.title: Product Manager
pm.summary: Translates intent into requirements, acceptance criteria, product boundaries, and prioritization signals.

architect.title: Architect
architect.summary: Shapes technical plan structure, dependencies, architecture boundaries, integration seams, and delivery slices.

developer.title: Developer
developer.summary: Focuses on implementation-ready candidate work under CLike governance and candidate-first isolation.

ux.title: UX
ux.summary: Focuses on user journeys, interaction requirements, accessibility, and experience acceptance criteria.

qa.title: QA
qa.summary: Advises on test evidence, quality risks, acceptance coverage, and deterministic validation signals.

tech-writer.title: Technical Writer
tech-writer.summary: Prepares release-facing summaries, documentation clarity, and evidence-based finalization notes.
